label: Potential lower bound on selected-world actual concreta
term: potential lower bound on selected-world actual concreta
definition: One real lower bound L satisfies L <= S x for every x concrete and existing at the one selected world w. The supplied S:B->Real is a coordinate on candidate beings, not integer time or a physical stock. Take S n=n, L=0 on an ascending chain. Negative S n=-n on reverse-successor grounding has no common lower bound.
note: Analyst mathematical framework; attribution deferred. Applicability to reality and any calibration of metaphysical grounding remain OPEN. No clock, temporal cause, entropy, necessity by own nature, causal completeness, transfinite converse or cross-world union is inferred.
